# Standard input has no package, so its author CSS is not known to be
# complete: a <style> element is not all the CSS a page may load. The
# interior of an element with a class is left as written; the section
# around it, which no author rule can reach, is indented.

stdin page.gohtml
muxt fmt
cmp stdout want.gohtml

-- page.gohtml --
<style>p{color:red}</style>
<section>
<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
</section>
-- want.gohtml --
<style>p{color:red}</style>
<section>
	<div class="code">
  keep   me
</div>
	</section>
